text:
At 6 foot 6 and 232 pounds, Michael McCarron plays the way you'd expect: 66 hits in 23 games, penalty killing, a heavy shot (his hardest is in the 94th percentile). What you might not expect is the scoring. He has 9 points with Minnesota, where it took him all of last season in Nashville to reach 17, and CBS Sports noted he is on a career pace.

Some of it holds up. His shooting, 10.5%, sits inside our range for him, and the Wild get 57.8% of the 5v5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on, 6.8 points better than without him. Evolving-Hockey had him taking chances away last season (90th percentile among forwards defensively), even if his overall value came out near replacement level.

Some of it is softer. His team has scored 3.4 more goals than its chances deserved with him out there, and his scoring rate is above the top of our range. A fourth-line role at about 14 minutes caps how far it can go. Our range for his season is 21 to 35 points.
